'''Rawst''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] and the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] of [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]]. He was killed on [[Aguarl 3]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces.
